Upstream FFTW has no merged RVV kernels (search shows only an open RVV pull request), so the win may be vectorized code against scalar FFTW. The 3x figure is from a first-party preprint (no peer review confirmed) that could not be opened; compiler and flags for the paper runs are unverified. Commits on 2026-09-23 (after the August 2026 preprint) fixed FFT sign constants in the C API, thread-private allocation of work arrays in 2-D transforms (a likely data race) and an undefined reference in the FFTW benchmark, so the published numbers predate correctness fixes. benchmark/README.md lists segmentation faults in some environments (raise system and OpenMP stack size). Fortran library with a C header (src/juffte.h) and an FFTW-compatible C API, so callable from C/C++ with -lgfortran. Young repo: 19 commits, 3 stars.
